items.title: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal
items.description: China worries the scandal could ramp up pressure on the US to further restrict the sale of advanced chips.

items.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
items.description: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

items.title: Rubio says US not 'under systemic attack' after series of tech outages
items.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was "zero evidence" supporting theories online that recent disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks and flights are connected.

items.title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
items.description: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.

items.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
items.description: Ukraine says the missile and drone attack on the strategic bridge in the Russian-annexed Crimea took weeks to plan.

items.title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
items.description: Moscow has targeted bridges in Kyiv, while Ukraine severely damaged a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.

items.title: Philippines police ask prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle over child sex abuse material
items.description: Markle is being held in custody in the US after one charge and has previously denied all of the allegations.

items.title: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
items.description: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.

items.title: Can a US-backed mineral highway bring peace and prosperity to DR Congo?
items.description: The Lobito Corridor is at the centre of a US-backed effort to secure access to Africa's critical minerals.

items.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
items.description: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.

items.title: Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage
items.description: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.

items.title: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
items.description: The Metropolitan Police say he has been taken into custody by the US Military over suspected national security and espionage allegations.

items.title: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
items.description: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.

items.title: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board
items.description: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.

items.title: Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed
items.description: Bilkis Bano has spoken of her "pain, shock and disbelief" at the top court order and vowed to fight back.

items.title: Nvidia partner Megaspeed being investigated by US government over chip exports
items.description: The Singapore-based company is suspected of helping to ship high-end AI chips from tech giant Nvidia to China, violating US export rules.

items.title: Trump says US taking 'very seriously' any Iranian plot against Washington
items.description: Tehran rejects any suggestion it was plotting a so-called dirty bomb attack on the US capital as "baseless".

items.title: BBC reports from Kyiv bridge hit by Russian attack
items.description: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford spoke to residents near the site of the overnight strike.

items.title: Inside the Chinese 'AI wonderland' where Xi will host Trump
items.description: The meeting will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen.

items.title: Will President Trump meet Kim Jong Un?
items.description: President Trump says he would be keen to meet the North Korea leader in China.
